details:
This is a feature request building off a similar one by icytheicewolf (https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/log-visited-worlds) who requested an automatic logging of visited worlds.

Assuming VRChat doesn't store world history beyond what you see in the Recently Visited section on the Worlds menu, worlds we've been to less recently likely won't get logged automatically so having a button somewhere to mark a world as visited would be necessary. There could be some sort of semi-transparent button that appears next to the platform icons when mousing over the thumbnail and clicking it would make it fully opaque even after mousing away. Alternatively, the thumbnail frame could be altered. Either way it's gotta be obvious without being too visually intrusive. 

This could open the door for a toggle to filter visited worlds when browsing the Worlds menu which would greatly assist in world discovery for lesser known worlds that still deserve a visit.
title: Option to mark worlds as visited
